svg.title: Schematic long section up the Awaji Yumebutai slope after the work: from the sea and the coast road, through the sectioned buildings, down into the oval forum, up past the stepped water courts and the hundred terraced beds of Hyakudan-en to woodland at the top, with the visitor route drawn as a single line.

g.text: The same slope after the work:
one section from the sea up to
SCHEMATIC — sequence and relative levels only. Heights, gradients and distances are
indicative, no measured drawing was consulted, and the total climb carries no figure.
